title: Statistical significance (Fisher z-transformation) of the tracked sentiment correlations

tables.name: Correlation, 95% CI, and p-value per signal

notes: Prior status checks reported correlation coefficients (e.g. 2026-08-17: pooled -0.077 n=223, LLM -0.047 n=204) without a formal significance test -- this fills that gap using Fisher's z-transformation (standard method, computed directly since scipy isn't available in this environment). Stone #5 of 6 in the user's 2026-08-18 'turn over every stone' sentiment review.

conclusion.summary: None of the tracked correlations' 95% CIs exclude zero -- every 'weak correlation' finding in this investigation (pooled sentiment, LLM score, mentions_24h) is statistically indistinguishable from noise at current sample sizes. This doesn't prove there's no real effect, just that we don't have enough data yet to tell a real small effect apart from pure chance.
